text: Hello, is this Kim Jiwoo at Mangwon Heights three oh two? This is Team Leader Baek from the billing team at Mapo City Gas.
Your September gas bill, eighteen thousand, four hundred and twenty won, has not been paid. The gas to your unit will be shut off at five o'clock today.
Ma'am? Can you hear me?
The auto-payment failed, ma'am. It happens when a bank updates its system.
The shut-off is automatic, ma'am. The system doesn't take holidays.
To stop it, please transfer eighteen thousand, four hundred and twenty won to our collection account. Hanbit Bank, six two zero, three three nine, one zero four seven seven two.
As soon as it arrives, I'll cancel the shut-off. I'll stay on the line while you send it.
It's our collection officer's, Han Sungmin. On a holiday, payments go through his account.
The centre is closed today, ma'am, so I'm calling from my work mobile.
Of course, ma'am, but please be quick. The shut-off order is already in the system.
Ma'am? Are you still there?
I'm still holding, ma'am. The shut-off is set for five.
One hour left, ma'am. After that I can't stop it.
Twenty minutes. Please send it now.
Five minutes, ma'am!
It's five o'clock, ma'am.
Fine. Don't blame us when the gas goes off.
Thank you, ma'am. I've cancelled the shut-off.
Enjoy the rest of your holiday.

입금이 확인되는 대로 차단을 취소해 드릴게요. 보내시는 동안 기다리겠습니다.
수납 담당자 한성민 명의입니다. 공휴일에는 담당자 계좌로 받고 있어요.
오늘은 고객센터가 쉬는 날이라 업무용 휴대폰으로 연락드렸어요.
네, 확인하세요. 하지만 서둘러 주셔야 해요. 차단 접수가 이미 들어가 있어서요.
고객님? 듣고 계세요?
아직 기다리고 있습니다. 차단은 다섯 시로 잡혀 있어요.
한 시간 남았습니다. 그 뒤엔 저도 막을 수 없어요.
이십 분 남았어요. 지금 보내 주세요.
오 분 남았습니다!
다섯 시가 됐습니다, 고객님.
알겠습니다. 가스가 끊겨도 저희 탓은 하지 마세요.
감사합니다, 고객님. 차단은 취소해 드렸어요.
남은 연휴 잘 보내세요.
Hello, is this Kim Jiwoo? This is Manager Jeon from Nuri Bank's account protection team.
Twenty minutes ago, someone logged into your account from an unregistered device in Busan.
Miss Kim? Are you still there? This is urgent.
That's exactly why I'm calling. A fraud ring is emptying accounts in Mapo today, and yours is on their list.
I have your account ending in eight, eight, one, four on my screen, Miss Kim.
We're the protection team, not the call centre, so we call from our direct line.
To keep your savings safe, we'll move them to a protected account until the security reset at five o'clock.
Please transfer one million, two hundred thousand won to the protected account. Nuri Bank, one one zero, nine zero zero, five five one two zero seven.
Stay on the line and don't tell anyone. The fraud ring may be watching your messages.
I'll hold while you open your bank app. It has to be done before five.
The call centre can't see protection cases, Miss Kim. If you hang up, the case closes and the fraud ring gets your money.
Please, just stay with me.
It's registered to our security officer, Jeong Miran. Protection accounts are always in an officer's name.
It's our team's direct line, Miss Kim. Every bank uses internet lines for calls like this.
Miss Kim? Are you still there? Please don't put me on hold for long.
I've opened a protection case for you, Miss Kim, so this is official. Please finish the transfer.
The fraud ring just tried to log in again. We need that transfer now, Miss Kim.
Seven minutes. After the reset I can't protect anything.
Three minutes! Please, transfer it now!
Miss Kim? It's five o'clock.
Fine. Your account will be frozen. Don't call us when it's empty.
Thank you, Miss Kim. Your money is safe with us now.
Don't tell anyone until tomorrow's reset.

Oh, thank you. You're a lifesaver. See you on Saturday!
